title: FIRST AID
note: FIELD REFERENCE. NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR TRAINING. WHEN IN DOUBT, CALL 911.
source: LAYPERSON GUIDANCE AFTER AMERICAN RED CROSS / AHA

items.title: CPR · ADULT
call: NO RESPONSE AND NOT BREATHING NORMALLY · CALL 911 FIRST, SEND SOMEONE FOR AN AED
steps: TAP AND SHOUT. CHECK FOR NORMAL BREATHING, NO MORE THAN 10 SEC.
PERSON FLAT ON THEIR BACK ON A FIRM SURFACE.
HEEL OF ONE HAND ON THE CENTER OF THE CHEST, OTHER HAND ON TOP, ARMS STRAIGHT.
PUSH HARD AND FAST: 2 TO 2.4 IN DEEP, 100 TO 120 PER MINUTE. LET THE CHEST COME ALL THE WAY BACK UP.
IF TRAINED, GIVE 2 BREATHS AFTER EVERY 30 PUSHES. IF NOT, KEEP PUSHING WITHOUT STOPPING.
WHEN THE AED ARRIVES, TURN IT ON AND DO WHAT IT SAYS.
KEEP GOING UNTIL HELP TAKES OVER OR THE PERSON STARTS BREATHING.
dont: DO NOT STOP TO CHECK FOR A PULSE.

items.title: CHOKING · ADULT
call: THEY CANNOT BREATHE, COUGH OR TALK
THEY GO LIMP · START CPR
steps: IF THEY CAN COUGH HARD, LET THEM KEEP COUGHING.
IF NOT: STAND BEHIND, LEAN THEM FORWARD, GIVE 5 FIRM BLOWS BETWEEN THE SHOULDER BLADES.
THEN 5 ABDOMINAL THRUSTS: FIST JUST ABOVE THE NAVEL, OTHER HAND OVER IT, PULL IN AND UP.
REPEAT 5 AND 5 UNTIL THE OBJECT COMES OUT OR THEY GO LIMP.
PREGNANT OR TOO LARGE TO REACH AROUND: CHEST THRUSTS INSTEAD.
IF THEY GO LIMP, LOWER THEM DOWN, CALL 911 AND START CPR.
dont: NO BLIND FINGER SWEEPS IN THE MOUTH.

items.title: SEVERE BLEEDING
call: BLOOD SPURTS OR WILL NOT SLOW WITH PRESSURE
SIGNS OF SHOCK
steps: GLOVES OR A BARRIER IF YOU HAVE ONE.
PRESS HARD, STRAIGHT ON THE WOUND, WITH A CLEAN CLOTH. KEEP STEADY PRESSURE.
IF IT SOAKS THROUGH, ADD MORE ON TOP. DO NOT LIFT THE FIRST LAYER.
DEEP WOUND: PACK CLOTH INTO IT, THEN PRESS.
ARM OR LEG STILL GUSHING: TOURNIQUET 2 TO 3 IN ABOVE THE WOUND, NOT ON A JOINT.
TIGHTEN UNTIL THE BLEEDING STOPS. NOTE THE TIME. LEAVE IT ON FOR EMS.
dont: DO NOT REMOVE AN EMBEDDED OBJECT. PRESS AROUND IT.

items.title: SHOCK
call: ALWAYS · SHOCK IS AN EMERGENCY
steps: SIGNS: PALE OR GRAY, COOL CLAMMY SKIN, FAST WEAK PULSE, FAST BREATHING, CONFUSION.
LAY THEM FLAT ON THEIR BACK.
NO HEAD, NECK, BACK OR LEG INJURY: RAISE THE FEET ABOUT 12 IN.
TREAT WHAT CAUSED IT, LIKE BLEEDING.
KEEP THEM WARM WITH A BLANKET OR COAT.
STAY WITH THEM AND WATCH BREATHING.

items.title: BURNS
call: LARGER THAN THE PALM, DEEP, OR CHARRED
FACE, HANDS, FEET, GROIN OR A JOINT
CHEMICAL, ELECTRICAL OR SMOKE INHALED
steps: STOP THE BURNING. GET AWAY FROM THE SOURCE.
COOL WITH COOL RUNNING WATER FOR 10 TO 20 MIN.
TAKE OFF RINGS, WATCHES AND TIGHT CLOTHES BEFORE IT SWELLS.
COVER LOOSELY WITH CLEAN PLASTIC WRAP OR A NON-STICK DRESSING.
ELECTRICAL: CUT THE POWER BEFORE YOU TOUCH THEM.
dont: NO ICE, BUTTER OR OINTMENT ON A FRESH BURN.
DO NOT POP BLISTERS OR PULL OFF STUCK CLOTHING.

items.title: HEAT ILLNESS
call: CONFUSED, SLURRING, PASSED OUT OR SEIZING · HEAT STROKE
HOT SKIN WITH LITTLE SWEAT
VOMITING OR NOT IMPROVING IN 1 HOUR
steps: HEAT EXHAUSTION: HEAVY SWEAT, COOL CLAMMY SKIN, CRAMPS, NAUSEA, DIZZY, WEAK.
MOVE TO SHADE OR A/C. LOOSEN CLOTHES. COOL WET CLOTHS. SIP WATER OR A SPORTS DRINK.
HEAT STROKE: CONFUSION OR ODD BEHAVIOR, HOT SKIN, FAST PULSE. THIS IS LIFE THREATENING.
FOR HEAT STROKE CALL 911 AND COOL FAST: COLD WATER ON THE BODY OR IMMERSION, ICE PACKS AT NECK, ARMPITS AND GROIN, FAN THEM.
KEEP COOLING UNTIL EMS ARRIVES.
dont: NO FLUIDS FOR ANYONE CONFUSED OR NOT FULLY AWAKE.

items.title: HYPOTHERMIA
call: CONFUSED, VERY DROWSY, OR SHIVERING HAS STOPPED
steps: GET THEM OUT OF THE COLD, WIND AND WET.
SWAP WET CLOTHES FOR DRY. HANDLE THEM GENTLY.
WARM THE CORE FIRST: BLANKETS, SKIN TO SKIN, WARM PACKS AT CHEST, NECK AND GROIN.
ALERT AND ABLE TO SWALLOW: WARM SWEET DRINKS, NO ALCOHOL.
WATCH BREATHING. START CPR IF IT STOPS.
dont: DO NOT RUB ARMS AND LEGS OR USE VERY HOT WATER.

items.title: FRACTURE · SPRAIN
call: BONE THROUGH THE SKIN OR LIMB BADLY BENT
COLD, PALE OR NUMB BELOW THE INJURY
HEAD, NECK, BACK OR HIP INJURY · DO NOT MOVE THEM
steps: KEEP IT STILL, IN THE POSITION YOU FOUND IT.
SPLINT ONLY IF YOU MUST MOVE THEM: PAD IT AND TIE ACROSS THE JOINTS ABOVE AND BELOW.
CHECK FINGERS OR TOES STAY WARM AND PINK. LOOSEN TIES IF NOT.
ICE WRAPPED IN A CLOTH, 20 MIN ON, 20 OFF.
RAISE IT IF THAT DOES NOT HURT.
dont: DO NOT TRY TO STRAIGHTEN IT OR PUSH A BONE BACK IN.

items.title: ALLERGIC REACTION
call: TROUBLE BREATHING, SWOLLEN FACE OR THROAT, HIVES SPREADING, FAINT · CALL 911 EVEN IF IT IMPROVES
steps: HELP THEM USE THEIR EPINEPHRINE AUTO-INJECTOR RIGHT AWAY.
OUTER THIGH, THROUGH CLOTHING IS FINE. HOLD IT IN AS LONG AS THE DEVICE SAYS.
NOTE THE TIME. KEEP THE USED PEN FOR EMS.
LET THEM SIT UP IF BREATHING IS HARD. LIE FLAT WITH FEET UP IF FAINT.
NO BETTER AFTER 5 TO 15 MIN AND THEY HAVE A SECOND PEN: GIVE IT.
dont: DO NOT WAIT TO SEE IF IT GETS WORSE.

items.title: SEIZURE
call: LONGER THAN 5 MIN, OR ONE AFTER ANOTHER
FIRST EVER, INJURED, PREGNANT, IN WATER, OR NOT WAKING AFTER
steps: TIME IT FROM THE START.
MOVE HARD OR SHARP THINGS AWAY. CUSHION THE HEAD.
LOOSEN ANYTHING TIGHT AROUND THE NECK.
WHEN THE JERKING STOPS, ROLL THEM ONTO THEIR SIDE.
STAY UNTIL THEY ARE FULLY AWAKE. TALK CALMLY.

items.title: SNAKE BITE · STING
call: ANY VENOMOUS SNAKE BITE, OR IF UNSURE
SWELLING OF FACE OR THROAT, TROUBLE BREATHING · SEE ALLERGIC REACTION
steps: SNAKE: MOVE AWAY FROM IT. KEEP THE PERSON CALM AND STILL.
TAKE OFF RINGS, WATCHES, TIGHT CLOTHES NEAR THE BITE.
KEEP THE BITTEN LIMB STILL, ABOUT AT HEART LEVEL. WASH GENTLY, COVER LOOSELY.
NOTE THE TIME. A PHOTO OF THE SNAKE FROM A SAFE DISTANCE HELPS.
STING: SCRAPE THE STINGER OUT SIDEWAYS WITH A CARD. WASH. COLD PACK 10 MIN.
WATCH FOR ALLERGY SIGNS FOR AN HOUR.
dont: SNAKE: NO TOURNIQUET, NO CUTTING, NO SUCTION, NO ICE.
DO NOT TRY TO CATCH THE SNAKE.

items.title: EYE INJURY
call: CHEMICAL IN THE EYE
OBJECT STUCK IN THE EYE, OR VISION CHANGED
steps: CHEMICAL: FLUSH WITH CLEAN WATER FOR 15 TO 20 MIN, EYE HELD OPEN, RUNNING AWAY FROM THE OTHER EYE.
DUST OR GRIT: BLINK, FLUSH WITH WATER. DO NOT RUB.
OBJECT STUCK IN IT: LEAVE IT. PROTECT WITH A CUP OVER THE EYE.
COVER BOTH EYES LOOSELY SO THEY MOVE LESS.
BLOW TO THE EYE: COLD PACK, NO PRESSURE ON THE EYEBALL.
dont: DO NOT RUB OR PRESS ON THE EYE.

items.title: STROKE
call: ANY ONE SIGN · CALL 911 NOW AND NOTE THE TIME IT STARTED
steps: B · BALANCE: SUDDEN DIZZINESS OR LOSS OF BALANCE.
E · EYES: SUDDEN BLURRED, DOUBLE OR LOST VISION.
F · FACE: ASK THEM TO SMILE. ONE SIDE DROOPS.
A · ARMS: RAISE BOTH. ONE DRIFTS DOWN.
S · SPEECH: SLURRED OR STRANGE.
T · TIME: CALL 911. NOTE WHEN THE SIGNS STARTED.
KEEP THEM COMFORTABLE. WATCH BREATHING.
dont: DO NOT LET THEM DRIVE OR SLEEP IT OFF.
